bracketRules.title: Official Bracket Challenge rules
items: The top-scoring bracket earns an extra 5 points in the season standings.
You do not need to be in the In-Season Challenge for your bracket to count.
Your bracket must be completed and sent before the start of Darlington (Race 6, Monday 11/16).

changelog.t: Added a Make recap image button on the Results tab. It builds a shareable picture of the race.
Fixed the comeback stat so races with fewer than 15 cars, like Texas, now count.
Added a points to catch number for the driver ahead on every Tower row.
Cleaned up race data so all races use one format. No points or standings changed. Race 1 stage order now shows on the Stage tab.
Added this update note, change list and an automatic data check.
